# BRC Brake Chambers

> Premium aftermarket manufacturer of heavy-duty commercial vehicle brake chambers, air disc brake actuators, and replacement components. Manufactured in Zhejiang, China with IATF 16949-aligned quality systems and distributed globally across 30+ countries.

BRC Brake Chambers manufactures and supplies OEM-grade air brake actuators for heavy-duty semi-trucks, commercial trailers, vocational fleets, transit buses, and off-highway equipment. Direct interchange replacements available for Bendix, Meritor, Haldex, Wabco, and MGM Brakes.

## Core Product Categories

- [All Products](https://www.brakechambers.com/products): Complete online catalog of heavy-duty brake chambers, actuators, and hardware.
- [Spring Brake Chambers](https://www.brakechambers.com/spring-brake-chambers): Double-diaphragm parking and emergency spring brakes.
  - Type 30/30 Standard Stroke (2.5") and Long Stroke (3.0")
  - Type 24/30 & Type 24/24 Spring Brakes
  - Type 20/24 Vocational Spring Brakes
  - Type 36/36 Heavy-Haul Spring Brakes
  - Type 30/30 Piggyback Replacement Kits
- [Service Brake Chambers](https://www.brakechambers.com/service-brake-chambers): Single-diaphragm service chambers for steer, drive, and trailer axles.
  - Type 30 Service Chambers (Standard and Long Stroke)
  - Type 24 & Type 20 Steer-Axle Chambers
  - Type 12 & Type 16 Service Chambers
  - Welded Clevis Brake Chambers
- [Air Disc Brake Actuators](https://www.brakechambers.com/air-disc-brake-actuators): Advanced disc brake actuators for modern commercial vehicle ADB systems.
  - Type 16/18 ADB Actuators
  - Type 20/24 ADB Actuators
  - Type 24/24 & 24/30 ADB Actuators
- [Chamber Parts & Rebuild Kits](https://www.brakechambers.com/parts-and-kits): OEM-spec replacement diaphragms, clamp bands, caging tools, and hardware.
  - Heavy-Duty Rubber Diaphragms (Type 30, Type 24, Type 20, Type 16)
  - Air Brake Chamber Rebuild Kits
  - Caging Bolts & Safety Release Tools
  - Automatic & Manual Slack Adjusters

## OEM Cross-Reference Database

- [OEM Cross-Reference Hub](https://www.brakechambers.com/oem-cross-reference): Instant part number interchange and crossover tool.

## Manufacturing & Quality Standards

- [Manufacturing Hub](https://www.brakechambers.com/manufacturing): Large-scale production facility in Zhuji, Zhejiang, China.
- [Production Process](https://www.brakechambers.com/manufacturing/process): Deep-draw steel stamping, automated robotic welding, and e-coat corrosion protection.
- [Quality Assurance](https://www.brakechambers.com/manufacturing/quality-assurance): 100% pneumatic leak testing, cyclic fatigue testing, burst pressure validation (FMVSS 121 compliance).
- [Custom OEM & Private Label](https://www.brakechambers.com/manufacturing/custom-oem): Custom stroke specifications, port configurations, and branded packaging for wholesale distributors.
